interview.name: Uli
interview.answer: The repair drive location and time are not confirmed yet.

reflections: Rosa is coordinating the repair drive and is relying on Uli to help organize tasks.
Uli is willing to help but wants a clear list of what needs attention before acting.
Rey is proactive and offers practical support, especially by prioritizing the quickest repairs first.
Uli is acting as a practical coordinator who helps people organize tasks, not just complete them.
Rey and Gus respond positively to Uli’s support and are willing to take on follow-up work.
Hana is focused on clarifying the basics and scope before moving ahead, which suggests the group still needs shared context.
Uli is acting as a steady coordinator, giving practical next steps while admitting uncertainty about the full situation.
Gus and Dane respond well to direct, task-focused guidance and are ready to help once given a concrete starting point.
Hana needs essential logistics before she can engage effectively, so the group may benefit from sharing date, location, and scope early.
Uli is the central coordinator, and others consistently defer to Uli for status, lists, and timing.
Dane takes a proactive support role, asking for direction and starting on smaller repairs immediately.
Bo and Gus mainly wait on Uli for final details, while offering to stay ready and help once the missing items or timing are confirmed.
Uli is the main coordinator, collecting confirmations and tracking missing items for others.
Gus and Vik are responsive and appreciative, relying on Uli to organize follow-up details.
The group is coordinating practical event logistics with pending confirmations on timing, supplies, and repair details.

events.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. If you’re free, we can go over what needs fixing and who’s available.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Uli: Hi Rosa. I can help go over it, yes — just tell me what needs fixing.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Uli — that’s a big help. I’ve got a few things to sort: the loose gate latch, a leaky faucet at the community room, and a couple of folks who already said they might be available.
events.speaker: Rosa

events.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you need an extra pair of hands. What’s the plan for today?
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Rey. I’m just trying to sort the list and see what can actually get done today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Rey: That makes sense. If you want, I can help sort the list and pick the quickest fixes first.
events.speaker: Rey

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — could you help me sort the donated tools and check what’s still missing?
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Uli: Sure, Gus. I can sort the tools and see what’s still missing.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. Let me know what’s missing, and I’ll keep an eye out for the rest.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Hana: I’m still missing the basics—what’s the date, location, and what repairs are we collecting for?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Uli: I’m not sure of the full details yet — I’m just helping sort what needs fixing and what can be done today.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Hana: Got it — let’s start with what’s in front of us today. What items need fixing, and where should we focus first?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Dane: Hey Uli, I’m a bit late—what still needs doing at the repair drive? I can jump in and help right away.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Uli: Hey Dane, I’m just sorting what still needs fixing today. If you can, start with the small repairs and I’ll point you to the rest.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll start on the small repairs and keep things moving. Point me to the first one.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — keep me posted on the final time, and I’ll head to the garage when I can.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Uli: Will do — I’m still sorting the details, but I’ll let you know as soon as the final time’s set.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll be ready once you send the final time.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — that’d be a big help. Once you’ve sorted them, let me know what’s still missing and I’ll keep an eye out for the rest.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Uli: Sure thing, Gus. I’ll sort through them and make a quick list of what we still need.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Gus: Thanks, Uli — I really appreciate it. Let me know what’s missing, and I’ll keep an eye out for the rest.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the final start time, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I have it. If you can help sort donations or load boxes, that’d be a big help.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik — I can sort donations and help load boxes once you send the start time.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Vik: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send the start time as soon as it’s confirmed and keep you posted.
events.speaker: Vik

events.text: Uli: Hi Opal — I’m sorting out what still needs fixing today. If you’re free, I can point you to a small repair and we’ll go from there.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Opal: Hi Uli — I’m free, and I’m still keeping an ear out for the repair drive location. If you point me to the small repair, I can note it down and keep tracking any confirmed updates.
events.speaker: Opal

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Opal — please note the small repair and keep tracking the location for now. I’ll share the confirmed spot as soon as I have it.
events.speaker: Uli
